title: Constructible sheaves of modules on a qcqs scheme: global partition iff affine-local (Stacks 095E)
statement: Let $T$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, $\Lambda$ a finite commutative ring and $\mathcal F$ a sheaf of $\Lambda_T$-modules on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. The following are equivalent: (1) (Stacks 03RW(3)) for every affine open $U\subseteq T$ there is a finite partition $U=\coprod_iU_i$ of $U$ into pairwise disjoint locally closed subsets $U_i$ which are constructible subsets of $U$ [def-weil-constructible-subset], such that, giving $U_i$ its reduced induced subscheme structure with immersion $u_i:U_i\to T$, the inverse image $u_i^{-1}\mathcal F$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image] is finite locally constant as a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]; (2) there is an open covering $T=\bigcup_jV_j$ such that each restriction $\mathcal F|_{V_j}$ satisfies (1) on the scheme $V_j$; (3) $\mathcal F$ is constructible in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] (a finite partition of $T$ by constructible locally closed subsets with immersed schemes on whose inverse images $\mathcal F$ is finite locally constant).

source.place: Lemma 095E (lemma-constructible-quasi-compact-quasi-separated), the statement for sheaves of Lambda-modules with Lambda Noetherian ('A similar statement holds'), here Lambda finite, and its proof; Stacks' condition 'of finite type and locally constant' in 03RW(3) is, for Lambda finite, the finite-locally-constant condition used here by lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-constant-module-values ((1) iff (3)); Definition 03RW (definition-constructible) and the paragraph before it (reduced induced structure, topological invariance 03SI); uses Topology Lemma 09Y4 (topology-lemma-constructible-partition-refined-by-stratification), Topology Lemma 'quasi-compact-open-immersion-constructible-image', Properties Lemma 'locally-constructible'.
